Engine operators and active batches/localized results have separate memory requirements. Nested zip levels own separate budgets.

One producer advance/spill/commit task survives consumer cancellation; other consumers wait for its committed batch or error. Retained streams/files drop with action ownership; tests cover cancelled-reader resume and fresh success/failure/recovery.
